title: For Freaky Girls Podcast
author: For Freaky Girls Podcast
description: Hey Freak-a-Leek! Meet Francene, Maiya & Felicia. We are three friends from the Midwest that LOVE great sex and juicy girl talk. We are here to bring you candid discussions about sex, health and wellness from a middle aged woman's perspective. We keep it real, raw and raunchy! Nothing is off limits, and trust us when we say that we are here for all of the sexual shenanigans. We will be sharing stories of our personal experiences, answering questions submitted from our viewers and have guests appearances with professionals and everyday women just like you.
